changelog.zh: 把所有版本面对齐：回填了 0.2.0/0.3.0/0.4.0 三个小版本的 CHANGELOG 条目（此前头部仍是 0.1.0，而二进制已是 0.4.0），给 site.json 补上 content_version，并加了一个单一真源锁步测试，断言 VERSION、--version、CHANGELOG 头部、站点 content_version 四处一致。
changelog.en: Put every version surface back in lockstep: backfilled the missing 0.2.0/0.3.0/0.4.0 CHANGELOG entries (the head still read 0.1.0 while the binary reported 0.4.0), added a content_version to site.json, and added a single-source-of-truth lockstep test asserting VERSION, --version, the CHANGELOG head, and the site content_version all agree.

changelog.zh: 握手冒烟测试现在在独立进程组里启动 server，结束时装组杀掉整个进程树——npx/uvx 拉起的 node/python 子进程不再被孤立成孤儿占用资源。README「实测输出」里的备份文件名已对齐真实格式（.mcpx.bak.<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.毫秒>）。
changelog.en: The handshake smoke test now launches the server in its own process group and tears down the whole tree on exit — the node/python grandchild that npx/uvx spawns is no longer orphaned to leak a runtime process on every handshake. The README "real output" backup filename now matches the real format (.mcpx.bak.<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.mmm>).
